{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-ga-c","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"ee50242efa930855f015282a6ac7b64c577b0874e61b62a0abb7e52bba6a3d49","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-ga-class-c:lineage:20","source_registry_sha256":"e082bc406bec2cfadcd011c884a136274a0200b40ae5a1536777a259a1b09eb3","source_liveness_sha256":"899bb7b77ecc9a36dd3203950c0cfa2065e4529a11881605f77eacb7d739a757"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Turning, parking, speed and railroad crossings","heading":"Turning, parking, speed and railroad crossings","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## Turning, parking, speed and railroad crossings

FACT_ID: sec05-F01 | anchor: A01
A turning driver's green light may coincide with a pedestrian's walk signal. Before turning, stop for pedestrians in the receiving road's crosswalk until they clear the lanes you will use. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F02 | anchor: A01
Do not make a U-turn where a sign forbids it, or on a curve or near a hillcrest when approaching drivers from either direction cannot see you. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F03 | anchor: A01
A left turn across the centerline of a multilane two-way road must comply with any controlling signs or signals and yield to opposing traffic. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F04 | anchor: A01
Before turning left, wait for pedestrians to clear the traffic lanes, sidewalk, driveway or alley being entered. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F05 | anchor: A01
Parking on a highway is prohibited. If a vehicle becomes disabled, make practical efforts to move it off the highway while leaving traffic room and visibility of the vehicle for 200 feet in both directions. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F06 | anchor: A01
Never stop, stand or park beside another parked vehicle on its street side, on a sidewalk, in an intersection or on a crosswalk. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F07 | anchor: A01
Do not stop, stand or park between a safety zone and its neighboring curb, or beside a street obstruction or excavation when that would obstruct traffic. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F08 | anchor: A01
Stopping, standing and parking are prohibited on a bridge or overpass, inside a highway tunnel, on railroad tracks or on a controlled-access road. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F09 | anchor: A01
Do not stop, stand or park in the area separating divided-highway roadways, including a crossover, or at a location signed against parking. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F10 | anchor: A01
In front of a driveway, the handbook permits a stop only briefly to collect or discharge passengers. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F11 | anchor: A01
Within 15 feet of a hydrant, the handbook permits stopping only momentarily for passengers. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F12 | anchor: A01
Within 20 feet of an intersection crosswalk, a stop is permitted only momentarily to load or unload passengers. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F13 | anchor: A01
Within 30 feet of a stop sign, yield sign or traffic signal, the handbook permits only a momentary passenger pickup or drop-off. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F14 | anchor: A01
Within 20 feet of a fire-station driveway, or within 75 feet of the point opposite it across the street, the handbook allows only a momentary stop for passengers. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F15 | anchor: A01
Within 50 feet of a rail crossing, or where official signs prohibit standing, the handbook permits only a brief passenger pickup or discharge. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F16 | anchor: A01
To start parallel parking, pass the chosen space and stop approximately alongside the car in front of it, leaving about 2 feet between the vehicles. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F17 | anchor: A01
On the passing lane of a multilane road, move right for faster traffic approaching from behind, regardless of your own speed, unless a stated exception applies. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F18 | anchor: A01
The passing-lane move-right rule allows exceptions when traffic, weather, an obstruction or another hazard makes staying in that lane necessary. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F19 | anchor: A01
Staying in the passing lane may be necessary to comply with a law or traffic-control device, to leave the road or turn left, or to pay a toll or use a toll pass. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F20 | anchor: A01
Authorized emergency vehicles on official duty and vehicles performing highway construction or maintenance are exceptions to the described passing-lane move-right rule. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=21]

FACT_ID: sec05-F21 | anchor: A02
When reversing into a parallel space, initially steer sharply right and back slowly. As the front door clears the forward car's rear bumper, straighten the wheels and continue diagonally. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-F22 | anchor: A02
Once the front bumper has cleared the car ahead during parallel parking, steer sharply left while reversing slowly, stopping before contact with the car behind. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-F23 | anchor: A02
To center the vehicle after reversing into the parallel space, select drive, steer right and pull forward carefully. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-F24 | anchor: A02
Use the proper turn signal before parallel parking and again before leaving the space. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-F25 | anchor: A02
Before reversing, check every side of the vehicle. While backing, turn to look over the right shoulder instead of relying only on mirrors. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-F26 | anchor: A02
For a bus or other large vehicle, use all mirrors and a reliable person to observe and direct the backing maneuver. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

Misconceptions: A parking diagram is not permission to stop where parking is prohibited; a passing-lane speed does not cancel the duty to move right when required.
Mnemonic: Space to stop, room to see, room to clear.
Glossary: A crossover connects the separated sides of a divided road; a minimum-speed sign states the lowest permitted travel speed under its conditions.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Speed statutes, fines, reinstatement charges and administrative enforcement retain current-law verification debt.
